name: 2N3906
source: onsemi 2N3906 データシート (2N3906/D Rev. 4, 2010-02)
description: PNP 汎用トランジスタ (TO-92, ピン1=E 2=B 3=C)。データシート (onsemi) の表と代表特性から作った等価モデル
hfe_note: データシートに hFE の typ が無いので、山の高さは表の min 100 と max 300 (10 mA) の幾何平均 173 に置きました。実物の hFE は、同じ型番でも 100〜300 と大きく違います。
remarks: hfe_norm: Figure 13 (read 2026-11-14). As for the 2N3904, no typical hFE: the peak (7 to 10 mA) is placed at 173, the geometric mean of the table's min 100 and max 300 at 10 mA (the table's min 60 / 80 / 60 / 30 at 0.1 / 1 / 50 / 100 mA stay below)

vbe_on, vbe_sat, vce_sat: Figure 15. Its printed axis labels (1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200 mA) sit on grid lines, but the grid lines between them are not a plain log axis: the current is read on a log scale between the two nearest labels.
cibo, cobo: Figure 3. The two curves meet above about 4 V; the one that goes on to 40 V is Cobo (VEBO is 5 V)
a PNP is fitted with magnitudes (the equations are the same)
